name: VenusBlood DarkChronicle Episode:4 Fushi no Shuujuu to Zetsubou no Matsuro
original_name: VenusBlood DarkChronicle Episode:4 不死の主従と絶望の末路
source:
Calmyra, who has crossed paths with Theophrad, along with her confidant Vanilla,
Calmyra and Vanilla, who had lost their way with Theohrad, stood up to stop the runaway growth of the magical city, but ...... they were captured.
What awaited them both in captivity was treatment as cattle, no better than an egg-laying mother's womb.
They are meat objects that have no free will whatsoever, and only continue to hatch eggs.
Even when they attempted to escape, they were mocked by a malevolence that went beyond their imagination. What will be the end of the poor sire and sisters? ......

translation:
卡尔米拉与提奥弗拉德有过交集，还有她的知己香草，
与泰奥拉德一起迷失方向的卡尔米拉和香草站起来阻止魔法都市失控的发展，但是……他们被俘虏了。
囚禁中等待他们的，是像牛一样的对待，与产卵的母亲的子宫一样。
它们是肉制品，没有任何自由意志，只会继续孵化蛋。
即使他们试图逃跑，也遭到了超乎他们想象的恶意的嘲笑。可怜的先生和姐妹们的结局会怎样呢？……
